note: Live sites crawled on a schedule so a crawlkit change that moves findings on a real site is measured rather than noticed. Counts are compared against the last committed baseline; deltas are reported, and only a site that crawls to zero pages fails the run. `pages` caps the crawl: these are trend signals, not audits. `render: true` means the crawl also runs with --javascript, which is what makes the raw-versus-rendered codes visible; wyattsnotes is the only registered site that renders content client-side.

targets.name: wyattsnotes
targets.why: Astro/Starlight behind Cloudflare. Rich canonical and metadata behaviour, and the site where the homepage-canonical bug was found.
